question: The marked price of an item is 25% above its cost price. A shopkeeper sells it, allowing a discount of x% on the marked price. If he incurs a loss of 8%, then the value of x is:
question_hi: किसी वस्तु का अंकित मूल्य उसकी लागत मूल्य से 25% अधिक है। एक दुकानदार अंकित मूल्य पर x% की छूट पर इसे बेचता है। यदि वह 8% की हानि उठाता है, तो x का मान है:
solution:
Let CP of the article be Rs. 100

MP of the article = 100 × (125/100) = Rs. 125

SP of the article = 100 × (92/100) = Rs. 92

Discount = 125 – 92 = 33

Discount percentage = 33/125 × 100 = 26.4%

Short Trick:

-8 = 25 – x – (25x/100)

-8 = 25 – x – x/4

5x/4 = 33

x = 132/5 = 26.4%

question: What x is added to each of 10, 16, 22 and 32, the numbers so obtained in this order are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between the numbers (x + 1) and (3x + 1)?
question_hi: 10, 16, 22 और 32 में से प्रत्येक में क्या x जोड़ा गया है, इस क्रम में प्राप्त संख्याएँ समानुपात में हैं, संख्याओं (x + 1) और (3x + 1) के बीच का मध्यानुपाती क्या है?
solution:

According to the question

question: The average of some numbers is 54.6. If 75% of the numbers are increased by 5.6 each, and the rest are decreased by 8.4 each, then what is the average of the numbers so obtained?
question_hi: कुछ संख्याओं का औसत 54.6 है। यदि 75% संख्या 5.6 से प्रत्येक की वृद्धि हुई है, और शेष 8.4 से प्रत्येक की कमी हुई है, तो संख्याओं का औसत कितना प्राप्त होता है?
solution:
Given:

Average of 4 numbers = 54.6

Concept Used:

Average = Sum of all Observation/ Number of Observation

Calculation:

Let us assume there are 4 numbers,

⇒ Sum of 4 numbers = 54.6 × 4 = 218.4

According to the question,

75% of the numbers of total numbers increased by 5.6 each

⇒ 4 × (3/4) × (54.6 + 5.6) = 3(54.6 + 5.6)

25% of the numbers of total numbers decreased by 8.4 each

⇒ 4 × (1/4) × (54.6 - 8.4) = (54.6 – 8.4) 

New sum of 4 numbers = 3(54.6 + 5.6) + (54.6 – 8.4)

⇒ New sum of 4 numbers = 3 × 60.2 + 46.2 = 180.6 + 46.2 = 226.8

New average of 4 numbers = 226.8/4 = 56.7

∴ The average of the numbers obtained is 56.7.

प्रश्नानुसार,

कुल संख्याओं की संख्या का 75% प्रत्येक में 5.6 की वृद्धि हुई

4 संख्याओं का नया औसत = 226.8/4 = 56.7

question: Reema sold 48 articles for Rs. 2,160 and suffered a loss of 10%. How many articles should she sell for Rs. 2,016 to earn a profit of 12%?
question_hi: रीमा ने 2,160 रुपये में 48 वस्तु बेचीं और उसे 10% का नुकसान उठाना पड़ा। कितनी वस्तुएँ उसे 2,016 रुपये में बेचना चाहिए जिससे उसे 12% का लाभ प्राप्त हो सके?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

Use the formula: (Price1 ÷ (Articles1 × (100 − Loss%))) = (Price2 ÷ (Articles2 × (100 + Profit%)))

2,160 ÷ (48 × 90) = 2,016 ÷ (n × 112)

2,160 ÷ 4,320 = 2,016 ÷ (n × 112)

1 ÷ 2 = 2,016 ÷ (n × 112)

n × 112 = 4,032 ⇒ n = 4,032 ÷ 112 = 36

∴ The correct answer is 36 articles.

Alternate Method

Given: Selling Price (SP1) = Rs. 2,160 for 48 articles, Loss = 10%. Target Profit = 12% for SP2 = Rs. 2,016.

Formulas: CP = SP × 100 ÷ (100 − Loss%) | SP = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

⇒ SP of 1 article = 2,160 ÷ 48 = Rs. 45

⇒ CP of 1 article = 45 × (100 ÷ 90) = Rs. 50

⇒ Required SP of 1 article for 12% profit = 50 × (112 ÷ 100) = Rs. 56

⇒ Number of articles for Rs. 2,016 = 2,016 ÷ 56 = 36

∴ The correct answer is 36 articles.

Additional Information

Unitary Method in P&L

When solving for multiple articles, it is often easiest to find the Cost Price (CP) of a single unit first.

Profit and Loss Percentage

Profit or Loss is always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless stated otherwise in the question.

सूत्र: CP = SP × 100 ÷ (100 − हानि%) | SP = CP × (100 + लाभ%) ÷ 100

⇒ 1 वस्तु का SP = 2,160 ÷ 48 = 45 रुपये

⇒ 1 वस्तु का CP = 45 × (100 ÷ 90) = 50 रुपये

⇒ 12% लाभ के लिए 1 वस्तु का आवश्यक SP = 50 × (112 ÷ 100) = 56 रुपये

⇒ 2,016 रुपये के लिए वस्तुओं की संख्या = 2,016 ÷ 56 = 36

∴ सही उत्तर 36 वस्तुएं है।

question: Diameter AB of a circle with centre O is produced to a point P such that PO = 16.8 cm. PQR is a secant that intersects the circle at Q and R such that PQ = 12 cm and PR = 19.2 cm. The length of AB (in cm) is:

From the following figure

Let the radius of the circle AO = OB = x, then

PA = (16.8 + x) and PB = (16.8 – x)

As we know,

PB × PA = PQ × PR

(16.8 – x) (16.8 + x) = 12 × 19.2

16.82 – x2 = 12 × 19.2

x2 = 0.36

x = 0.6

2x = 1.2

AB = 1.2

question: In ΔPQR, PQ = 24 cm and ∠Q = 58°. S and T are the points on side PQ and PR, respectively, such that ∠STR = 122°.If PS = 14 cm and PT = 12 cm, then the length of RT is:

question: A and B spend 60% and 75% of their incomes, respectively. If the savings of A are 20% more than that of B, then by what percentage is the income of A less than the income of B?
question_hi: A और B क्रमशः अपनी आय का 60% और 75% खर्च करते हैं। यदि A की बचत B की तुलना में 20% अधिक है, तो A की आय B की आय से कम कितने प्रतिशत है?
solution:
Using option 4

Assuming Income of A be 25% less than B

So, Income of A = 75, Income of B = 100

Savings of A  after expenditure of 60% = 75 - 60% of 75 = Rs.30

Savings of B after expenditure of 75% = 100 - 75% of 100 = Rs. 25

Savings of A is more than B by = (30 – 25)/25 × 100 = 20% (As the Question says the savings of A are 20% more than that of B Hence our assumption is correct)

Detailed Method:

Let the income of A and B be Rs. x and y respectively.

Savings of A = 40% of x

Savings of B = 25% of y

According to the question

(40% of x) = (25% of y) × (120/100)

x × 40% = y × 25% × 6/5

x : y = 3 : 4

Let income of A = 3 and income of B = 4

Income of A is less than that of B by = [(4 – 3)/4] × 100 = 25%

B की बचत  after expenditure of 75% = 100 - 75% of 100 = Rs. 25

A की बचत B से = (30 – 25)/25 × 100 = 20% (As the Question says the savings of A are 20% more than that of B Hence our assumption is correct)

A की बचत = x का 40%

B की बचत = y का 25%

प्रश्न के अनुसार

(40% x) = (25% y) × (120/100)

x × 40% = y × 25% × 6/5

x: y = 3: 4

question: A boat can go 3.6 km upstream and 5.4 km downstream in 54 minutes, while it can go 5.4 km upstream and 3.6 km downstream in 58.5 minutes. The time (in minutes) taken by the boat in going 10 km downstream is:
question_hi: एक नाव 3.6 किमी धारा के प्रतिकूल और 5.4 किमी धारा के अनुकूल 54 मिनट में जा सकती है, जबकि यह 5.4 किमी के प्रतिकूल और 3.6 किमी  के अनुकूल  58.5 मिनट में जा सकती है। 10 किमी धारा के अनुकूल जाने में नाव द्वारा लिया गया समय (मिनट में) है:
solution:
Short Trick:

U = upstream and D = downstream

3.6(U) + 5.4(D) = 54 and 5.4(U) + 3.6(D) = 58.5

Divide by 18

2U + 3D = 30 and 3U + 2D = 32.5

Now, Multiply by 3 in (1) and by 2 in (2), and then subtract (2) from (1), then

5D = 25 min

∴10D = 50 min

Detailed Method:

Let the speed of boat be x km/hr and speed of current be y km/hr

Upstream speed = (x – y) km/hr

Downstream speed = (x + y) km/hr

According to the question

3.6/(x – y) + 5.4/(x + y) = 54/60

5.4/(x – y) + 3.6/(x + y) = 58.5/60

Let 1/(x – y) = a and 1/(x + y) = b, then

3.6a + 5.4b = 54/60   ---(1)

5.4a + 3.6b = 58.5/60   ---(2)

Add equation (1) and equation (2)

9 (a + b) = 112.5/60

⇒a + b = 12.5/60

⇒a + b = 5/24   ---(3)

Subtract equation (2) from equation (1)

1.8 (b – a) = -4.5/60

⇒b – a = -2.5/60

⇒b – a = -1/24   ---(4)

Add equation (3) and equation (4)

2b = 4/24

⇒b = 1/12

⇒(x + y) = 12 km/hr

Downstream speed = 12 km/hr

∴Time taken to cover 10 km distance with downstream = 10/12 hr or (10/12) × 60 = 50 min

question: To complete a certain task, X is 40% more efficient than Y, and Z is 40% less efficient than Y. Working together, they can complete the task in 21 days. Y and Z together worked for 35 days. The remaining work will be completed by X alone in:
question_hi: एक निश्चित कार्य को पूरा करने के लिए, Y की तुलना में X 40% अधिक कुशल है, और Z, Y की तुलना में 40% कम कुशल है। एक साथ कार्य करने पर, वे 21 दिनों में कार्य पूरा कर सकते हैं। Yऔर Z ने मिलकर 35 दिनों तक काम किया। शेष कार्य X अकेले कितने दिन में पूरा करेगा?

Let efficiency of y be 5 unit

Efficiency of X = 5 × (7/5) = 7

Efficiency of Z = 5 × (3/5) = 3

Total work = (5 + 7 + 3) × 21 = 315

Work done by y and Z in 35 days = (5 + 3) × 35 = 280

Remaining work = 315 – 280 = 35

∴Remaining work will be completed by X alone in = 35/7 = 5 days

question: If the radius of a right circular cylinder is decreased by 10%, and the height is increased by 20%, then the percentage increase/decrease in its volume is:
question_hi: यदि लंब वर्त्तुल बेलन की त्रिज्या 10% कम हो जाती है, और ऊँचाई 20% बढ़ जाती है, तो इसका आयतन में प्रतिशत वृद्धि/कमी है:
solution:
Ratio of volume before and after = 500 : 486

Again multiply by 2 in = 1000 : 972

Volume decreased by = 1000 – 972 = 28

As we know, 28 = 2.8%

Detailed Solution:

Let the radius of the cylinder be r cm and height of the cylinder be h cm,

As we know,

Volume of the cylinder = πr2h

New radius of the cylinder = r × (90/100) = 0.9r cm

New height of the cylinder = h × (120/100) = 1.2h cm

New volume of the cylinder = π × (0.9r)2 × 1.2h = 0.81r2 × 1.2h × π = 0.972rhπ

Required percentage = [(πr2h - 0.972πrh)/πrh] × 100 = 2.8%

पहले और बाद की आयतन का अनुपात = 500: 486

फिर से 2 गुणा = 1000: 972 

आयतन में आयी कमी = 1000 - 972 = 28 

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं, 28 = 2.8%

विस्तृत हल:

बेलन नई ऊंचाई = h × (120/100) = 1.2h सेमी

बेलन का नया आयतन  = π × (0.9r)2 × 1.2h = 0.81r2 × 1.2h × π = 0.972rhπ

question: When a positive integer is divided by d, the remainder is 15. When ten times of the same number is divided by d, the remainder is 6. The least possible value of d is:
question_hi: जब किसी धनात्मक पूर्णांक को d से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो शेषफल 15 होता है। जब एक ही संख्या का दस गुणा d से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो शेषफल 6 होता है। d का न्यूनतम संभव मान है:
solution:
Given:

When a positive number is divided by d, the remainder is 15

When ten times of the same number is divided by d, the remainder is 6

Calculation:

As given, Remainder is 15 so we can say the value of d is greater than 15. Only 16 and 18 is greater than 15.

Let us try with the least of the two options

Since the minimum value for the positive number, for 15 to be remainder when divided by 16 = 31

Ten times of 31 = 310

310/16 → 6 (remainder) 

Since from there only we got the solution, we need not check for 18 as it is asked for the least value of d.

So the value of d is 16.
solution_hi:
दिया हुआ:

जब धनात्मक संख्या को d से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो शेष 15 होता है

जब एक ही संख्या के दस गुना को d से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो शेष 6 होता है

गणना:

जैसा कि दिया गया है, अवशेष 15 है, इसलिए हम कह सकते हैं कि d का मान 15. से अधिक है। केवल 16 और 18 का मूल्य 15 से अधिक है।

विकल्पों में से d = 16 लेना

15 = 150 का दस गुना

जब हम 150 को 16 से भाग देते हैं तो हम 6 शेष हो जाते हैं (स्थिति संतुष्ट)

question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral in which sides AD and BC are produced to meet at P, and sides DC and AB meet at Q when produced. If ∠A = 60° and ∠ABC = 72°, then ∠DPC –∠BQC = ?
question_hi: ABCD एक चक्रीय चतुर्भुज है जिसमें भुजा AD और BC, बिंदु P पर मिलते हैं और भुजा DC और AB, बिंदु Q पर मिलते हैं।  यदि ∠A = 60° और ∠ABC = 72° है, तो ∠DPC –∠BQC =?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

In a cyclic quadrilateral, opposite angles are supplementary: ∠D = 180° − ∠B = 180° − 72° = 108°.

The angle at the intersection of produced sides is given by ∠P = 180° − (∠A + ∠B) and ∠Q = 180° − (∠A + ∠D).

The difference ∠P − ∠Q = (180° − ∠A − ∠B) − (180° − ∠A − ∠D) = ∠D − ∠B.

∴ ∠DPC − ∠BQC = 108° − 72° = 36°.

∴ The correct answer is 36°.

Alternate Method

Given: ∠A = 60°, ∠ABC = 72° in cyclic quadrilateral ABCD.

Formula Used: Sum of opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°; Sum of angles in a triangle is 180°.

⇒ In cyclic quadrilateral ABCD, ∠ADC = 180° − ∠ABC

⇒ ∠ADC = 180° − 72° = 108°

⇒ In ΔPAB, ∠DPC = 180° − (∠A + ∠ABC)

⇒ ∠DPC = 180° − (60° + 72°) = 180° − 132° = 48°

⇒ In ΔQAD, ∠BQC = 180° − (∠A + ∠ADC)

⇒ ∠BQC = 180° − (60° + 108°) = 180° − 168° = 12°

⇒ ∠DPC − ∠BQC = 48° − 12° = 36°

∴ The correct answer is 36°.

Additional Information

Cyclic Quadrilateral Properties

The sum of opposite angles is always 180°. If one side is produced, the exterior angle formed is equal to the interior opposite angle.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles in any triangle is 180°. This property is used to find the angles at the intersection points P and Q.

General Formula

For a cyclic quadrilateral where sides meet at P and Q, the difference between the angles at P and Q is equal to the difference between the opposite interior angles.
solution_hi:
Shortcut Trick

एक चक्रीय चतुर्भुज (cyclic quadrilateral) में, सम्मुख कोण संपूरक (supplementary) होते हैं: ∠D = 180° − ∠B = 180° − 72° = 108°।

बढ़ाई गई भुजाओं के प्रतिच्छेदन पर बनने वाला कोण इस प्रकार दिया जाता है: ∠P = 180° − (∠A + ∠B) और ∠Q = 180° − (∠A + ∠D)।

अंतर ∠P − ∠Q = (180° − ∠A − ∠B) − (180° − ∠A − ∠D) = ∠D − ∠B।

∴ ∠DPC − ∠BQC = 108° − 72° = 36°।

∴ सही उत्तर 36° है।

Alternate Method

दिया गया है: चक्रीय चतुर्भुज (cyclic quadrilateral) ABCD में ∠A = 60°, ∠ABC = 72°।

प्रयुक्त सूत्र: चक्रीय चतुर्भुज में सम्मुख कोणों का योग 180° होता है; त्रिभुज (triangle) में कोणों का योग 180° होता है।

⇒ चक्रीय चतुर्भुज ABCD में, ∠ADC = 180° − ∠ABC

⇒ ∠ADC = 180° − 72° = 108°

⇒ ΔPAB में, ∠DPC = 180° − (∠A + ∠ABC)

⇒ ∠DPC = 180° − (60° + 72°) = 180° − 132° = 48°

⇒ ΔQAD में, ∠BQC = 180° − (∠A + ∠ADC)

⇒ ∠BQC = 180° − (60° + 108°) = 180° − 168° = 12°

⇒ ∠DPC − ∠BQC = 48° − 12° = 36°

∴ सही उत्तर 36° है।

Additional Information

चक्रीय चतुर्भुज के गुण

सम्मुख कोणों का योग हमेशा 180° होता है। यदि एक भुजा को बढ़ाया जाता है, तो बनने वाला बाह्य कोण आंतरिक सम्मुख कोण के बराबर होता है।

कोण योग गुण (Angle Sum Property)

किसी भी त्रिभुज के सभी आंतरिक कोणों का योग 180° होता है। इस गुण का उपयोग प्रतिच्छेदन बिंदुओं P और Q पर कोण ज्ञात करने के लिए किया जाता है।

सामान्य सूत्र

एक चक्रीय चतुर्भुज के लिए जहाँ भुजाएँ P और Q पर मिलती हैं, P और Q के कोणों के बीच का अंतर सम्मुख आंतरिक कोणों के बीच के अंतर के बराबर होता है।
